reasons.plausibility: It is scientifically well-founded that iron oxide films can confer corrosion protection in steels and become disrupted under high-temperature salt exposure, which aligns with well-documented corrosion behavior.
reasons.testability: The proposed side-by-side comparison of as-received and homogenized samples under carefully controlled salt-exposure conditions provides a clear, decisive way to confirm or refute the role of microstructural features.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the critical mechanisms of oxide stability and degradation in Q235 steel under relevant industrial conditions, offering a focused strategy to guide further research and materials optimization.
